audit.booking_engine: RezExpert for rooms (online.rezexpert.com/book?business_code=303844); slips by phone or email only
audit.concept_type: booking: room booking hand-off to RezExpert plus a slip request that builds the email their office asks for, with published dockage rates
must_keep: published dockage, mooring, power and water rates
slip request with boat type, name, LOA, beam, draft and dates
weaknesses: robots meta nofollow, noimageindex, nosnippet on the homepage
Wix stock images (rope, sailboat from above) where their own docks should be
slip requests must be typed by hand into an email
two phone numbers on different pages
no history, slip count or airport distance on their own site
audit.note: Family-run Marsh Harbour marina and inn on Wix; rooms book online, slips by hand-written email.
